head: ^worklog: internal error: TypeError: unhashable type: 'list'$
why: CPython raised an uncaught TypeError (a list as usage_provenance meets a set): a traceback naming the script's own lines. The Node names the same exception in one line, without a traceback, and keeps the exit code 1. A clean refusal (exit 2) would be better and is a behaviour change, so it is not made here.

head: ^worklog: internal error: TypeError: can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes$
why: A date-only snapshot boundary ('2026-09-01Z' reads as a naive datetime) against an aware one: CPython raised an uncaught TypeError with a traceback. The Node names the same exception in one line and keeps the exit code 1.

head: ^worklog: internal error: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes$
why: A date-only cutoff ('2026-10-01Z', naive) compared with an aware comment time: CPython raised an uncaught TypeError with a traceback. The Node names the same exception in one line and keeps the exit code 1.

head: ^worklog: internal error: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode the file '<D>/event.json'$
why: An input that is not UTF-8: CPython's read_text raised UnicodeDecodeError, which the script did not catch (a traceback). The Node names it in one line and keeps the exit code 1.
